text:
leah_supply: Argo sent an update 1: H100 tranche delayed +21d. They propose a hybrid flow: 4-unit air bridge for critical pods -> rest consolidated under single sea AWB to cut brokerage. Also offered depot repair for 3 DOA units at their EU depot. AWB: ARGO-773311. Thoughts?

daryl_ops: +21d is rough for apac planned capacity. Can we reshuffle eu-west and apac to cover both? Moving spares cross-region costs time and cash.

sanjay_sre: Warm spares: 8 H100-eq in us-west, 5 in eu-central. Cross-region transfer to apac is ~72-96h incl customs. We'll see shortfall in apac reserved pools if we don't air some hardware.

paola_fin: Cost view: Argo expedite baseline 6k for sub-batch. Sea consolidation saves ~k on brokerage for batch. Depot repair option reduces unit recovery cost but adds depot SLA risk. What's Argo discount if we sign consolidated RMA?

argo_freight_bot: Argo Freight: Confirmed ETA +21 days. Consolidation discount: 34% off expedite fee if consolidated RMA signed. Expedited 4-unit sub-batch discount: 48% if prepaid within 14h. Depot repair SLO: 4 business days. RMA ref: ARGO-R-7733. HS Code: 85423100, ECCN: EAR99.

leah_supply: If Argo holds 48% on 4-unit air and we prepay, that might let us keep apac QPS. But finance limit for emergency procurement is .5k. Paola?

paola_fin: If vendor discount nets <= .5k, I can approve. Need exact totals (vendor net + courier + customs brokerage prepay).

daryl_ops: Rough calc: vendor expedite 6k * 0.52 = .32k for sub-batch. Courier air for 4 units ~10 700. Total ~.02k. Slightly over. If Argo covers 20% of courier or we use alternate forwarder at 100 less, we can hit .5k.

argo_freight_bot: Argo Freight: We can cover 25% of courier for the air-leg if Redwood signs the consolidated sea AWB and accepts single RMA manifest. We will hold 48% sub-batch discount for 12h.

sanjay_sre: Operational: if replacements arrive in separate legs we require strict serial reconciliation and a provisioning remap hook. Example CSV we need: 

old_serial,new_serial,action,leg,photo_url
H100-0001,H100-0001,replace,air,https://img...
H100-0042,,repair,sea,https://img...

and a small remap script patch: 
```
# reconcile and remap incoming serials
# csv cols: old_serial,new_serial,action,leg
for row in csv_manifest:
  if row.action == 'replace':
    assign_serial_to_node(row.new_serial, lookup_old=row.old_serial)
  elif row.action == 'repair':
    mark_node_under_repair(row.old_serial)
```

henry_depot: Depot note: we can accept DOA and repair within 4bd but need pre-uploaded photos + failure log + signed manifest. If parts shortage discovered repair will escalate to replacement and ETA extends.

customs_bot: Customs notice: For cross-border air moves to APAC, pre-clear invoice + HS code needed >=12h before flight. For sea consolidation, port of discharge will require AWB + commercial invoice to avoid demurrage.

leah_supply: Action ask to Argo: 1) confirm 25% courier cover for air-leg in thread, 2) attach pro forma manifest template + photo template, 3) hold 48% sub-batch discount for 12h. Argo?

argo_freight_bot: Argo Freight: Confirmed in-thread: will cover 25% courier for the air leg if Redwood signs consolidated sea AWB and RMA by EOD. Pro-forma manifest template and photo checklist attached on agreement. Holding 48% discount for 12h.

paola_fin: With 25% courier cover totals: vendor net ~.32k + courier net ~.10 525 -> total ~.85k. That's within my emergency ceiling of .5k? Wait numbers mismatch. Leah re-run with exact courier quote (we have two forwarders).

daryl_ops: I have an alt forwarder quote: 10 450 for 4-unit air if we book now. Using that + Argo 25% cover -> courier ~10 337 -> total vendor net + courier ~.657k. Paola can sign up to .75k with product ops approval.

paola_fin: Okay I can approve up to .75k with product ops sign-off. Leah, do you have product ops looped?

leah_supply: I'll loop product ops now. Also firm up courier quote and request Argo attach manifest. If product ops ok, we prepay and sign consolidated RMA to capture discount and courier cover.

sanjay_sre: I'll draft the provisioning remap change and an audit note so we don't create duplicate node entries during the swap. Also will add alert to capacity tracking for APAC pods.

henry_depot: I'll prep the depot repair intake template and photo checklist; will standby for manifest.

leah_supply: Summary/actions: 1) leah_supply to confirm forwarder + final numbers, 2) argo_freight to attach pro-forma manifest and photo checklist, 3) paola_fin to sign if product ops confirms and totals <= €16.75k, 4) sanjay_sre to prepare remap + alerts, 5) henry_depot prep depot intake. Holding 48% discount for 12h.

daryl_ops: Marking APAC reserved pools as at-risk for 3 weeks. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
